title: +*INTRODUCTION TO CLIMATE CHANGE ECONOMICS AND POLICY
description: Introduces students to the economic intuition surrounding the climate change conundrum by identifying the role of economic theory, institutions, and data to help society address and adapt to the multi-dimensional problem. Explores challenges in global climate policy cooperation, inter-generational and equity issues in economic damages from climate change, and uncertainties inherent in climate policy decisions. Analyzes strategies to mitigate greenhouse gas emissions, including market-based solutions like carbon pricing, along with adaptation options related to sea-level rise, agriculture, forests and migration.
